dispute_ticket.description: I got charged S$6.50 as a no-show but the driver cancelled so quickly. I was in the mall toilet and came out as soon as I saw the notification. I think the fee should not apply.

chat_logs.content: Arrived at Tampines Mall drop-off point, white Alphard.
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 20s, no response).
Cancelling now, I cannot wait any longer.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $6.50 applied.
Just came out! Please come back

app_events.details: Rider R-4658 booked trip RYDE-CS-008 from Tampines Mall (Tampines Central 5 drop-off) to Bedok Reservoir. Pickup 17:20.
Driver D-8834 (Ong Kok Leong, Toyota Alphard (SKB 5021 M)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 2 min free wait period ends at 17:21.
Free 2-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 20s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-8834. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$6.50 charged to rider payment method (e-wallet).
Driver D-8834 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 17:19:00 and the driver cancelled at 17:26:00, a wait of 7 minutes. This trip's no-show threshold is 10 minutes, so the rider did not yet count as a no-show (short by 3 minutes). The driver cancelled early, so no fee is due and the S$6.50 is refunded to the rider.
